mock_data.title: A Birthday Party
mock_data.passage:
It was Julie's eighteenth birthday and her parents were holding a formal party to celebrate this red-letter day in their daughter's life. In fact, the day after the party was also going to be a red-letter day, not only for Julie, but also for many of her friends who would be at the party. That was the day the results of the final school exams were due to be announced, the moment of truth when some careers would be begun and others abandoned.

Perhaps it was not the best time to hold a party, but Julie had wanted to celebrate her birthday on the actual day, rather than postpone it until after the results were announced. Most of her student friends were glad to have something pleasant to do while they waited for the announcement which, as their English teacher said, would separate the sheep from the goats. Besides, after the results were known, not everyone would have something to celebrate.

Tonight, everyone was determined to forget about the results, let their hair down and have a good time, no matter what news the following day brought. As Tom said, 'Eat, drink and be merry, for tomorrow we die!' The students had been studying very hard for weeks before the exams, and there had not been time for much of a social whirl. Tonight they planned to make up for lost time. Julie's parents were quite well off and could afford to host a good party. There was to be a lavish buffet, champagne and a band to dance to. No expense had been spared.

It was not long until the start of the party and several of the girls had gathered at Julie's house so that they could enjoy the fun of getting ready together. They were all planning to get dressed up to the nines and so getting ready took a considerable time. Just as they had all finally finished, the doorbell rang and Mike, Julie's escort for the evening, appeared. 'Your chariot awaits!' he cried before telling Julie how beautiful she looked and that she would certainly be the belle of the ball.

The other girls' escorts soon joined Mike and everyone went off in taxis to the party, but not before Julie's father had a cautionary word for them. 'Have a wonderful time, but don't forget that big brother will be watching you.' No one was quite sure whether he was joking or not.
mock_data.passageB1:
It was Julie's eighteenth birthday, and her parents were having a party. It was a special day for Julie. The next day was also going to be important, not just for Julie, but for her friends too. That was the day they would get their final school exam results. It was a time when some people would start their dream jobs, and others would have to find a new plan.

Maybe it wasn't the best time for a party, but Julie wanted to celebrate her birthday on the right day. She didn't want to wait until after the results. Most of her friends were happy to have something fun to do while they waited. Their teacher said the results would show who had done well and who hadn't. Also, after the results, not everyone would be happy.

Tonight, everyone wanted to forget about the results. They wanted to relax and have fun, no matter what the next day brought. Tom said, 'Let's eat, drink, and be happy, because we don't know what tomorrow will bring!' The students had been studying hard for weeks before the exams. They didn't have time to go out. Tonight, they wanted to enjoy themselves. Julie's parents had enough money to have a good party. There was a big buffet, champagne, and a band to dance to. They spent a lot of money to make it a great party.

The party was about to start. Some of the girls met at Julie's house to get ready together. They were all planning to dress up nicely. It took a long time to get ready. When they were finally finished, the doorbell rang. It was Mike, Julie's date for the evening. He said, 'Your car is here!' He told Julie she looked beautiful and that she would be the most beautiful girl at the party.

The other girls' dates arrived soon after. Everyone left in taxis to go to the party. But before they left, Julie's father said something to them. He said, 'Have a good time, but remember I'm watching you.' No one knew if he was serious or joking.

At the party, the music was loud, and everyone was dancing. Julie felt grateful for her friends and family. She knew that whatever the exam results, she had people who cared about her. She smiled and joined her friends on the dance floor, determined to make the most of the evening.
mock_data.passageB2:
It was Julie's eighteenth birthday, a significant milestone, and her parents were throwing a formal party to celebrate. The following day held even more weight, not just for Julie but for many of her friends attending. It was the day their final exam results were due, a defining moment that would shape their futures, opening some doors while closing others.

Perhaps the timing wasn't ideal, but Julie insisted on celebrating her birthday on the actual date, rather than put it off until after the results. Most of her friends appreciated the chance to relax and enjoy themselves while waiting with bated breath for the announcement. As their English teacher had put it, the results would separate the wheat from the chaff. Besides, not everyone would be in a celebratory mood after learning their scores.

That night, everyone was determined to forget about the looming results and let their hair down, regardless of what the next day held. As Tom jokingly said, 'Eat, drink, and be merry, for tomorrow we die!' The students had been working tirelessly in the weeks leading up to the exams, leaving little room for socializing. Tonight, they intended to make up for lost time. Julie's parents were financially comfortable and could afford to host a lavish party, complete with a sumptuous buffet, champagne, and a live band for dancing. No expense was spared to ensure a memorable evening.

As the party drew near, several girls gathered at Julie's house, relishing the excitement of getting ready together. They planned to dress to impress, a process that took considerable time and effort. Just as they were putting the finishing touches on their looks, the doorbell rang. It was Mike, Julie's date for the evening. 'Your chariot awaits!' he exclaimed, complimenting Julie on her beauty and declaring that she would undoubtedly be the star of the show.

The other girls' dates soon arrived, and the group departed in taxis for the party. Before they left, Julie's father gave them a cautionary word. 'Have a wonderful time, but remember that I'll be keeping an eye on you.' It was unclear whether he was serious or simply joking, adding a touch of mystery to the evening's anticipation. They were all ready to paint the town red. The air crackled with excitement, and the party promised to be an unforgettable experience for everyone involved, a welcome distraction before facing the harsh realities of the exam results.
mock_data.passageC1:
Julie's eighteenth birthday was fast approaching, and her parents were orchestrating a lavish celebration to mark this momentous occasion in their daughter's life. The timing, however, was somewhat precarious. The following day was also poised to be a watershed moment, not only for Julie but also for many of her peers who would be in attendance at the party. The release of their final examination results loomed large, a veritable litmus test that would either validate years of academic toil or dash burgeoning aspirations.

While some might have questioned the wisdom of hosting a celebratory event on the eve of such a pivotal announcement, Julie had been resolute in her desire to commemorate her birthday on the actual date, come what may. For her classmates, the party offered a welcome respite, a chance to disengage from the mounting anxiety that preceded the unveiling of their academic fates. As their English teacher had so eloquently put it, the results would separate the wheat from the chaff, and the prospect of facing potentially disappointing outcomes cast a long shadow.

That evening, a collective decision was made to shelve all thoughts of impending academic judgment, to embrace the spirit of revelry, irrespective of what the morrow might bring. Echoing a sentiment of reckless abandon, Tom quipped, 'Eat, drink, and be merry, for tomorrow we may face the music!' The preceding weeks had been characterized by relentless studying, leaving scant room for social engagements. The party, therefore, presented an opportunity to recoup lost time and indulge in some well-deserved frivolity. Fortuitously, Julie's parents were financially comfortable and could foot the bill for an extravagant affair, complete with a sumptuous buffet, free-flowing champagne, and a live band to provide the soundtrack for the evening's festivities. Indeed, no expense had been spared in ensuring a memorable celebration.

As the appointed hour drew near, several of Julie's female friends had congregated at her residence, eager to partake in the pre-party ritual of getting ready together. They were all intent on dressing to impress, a process that inevitably consumed a considerable amount of time. Just as they had completed their transformations, the doorbell chimed, announcing the arrival of Mike, Julie's designated escort for the evening. With a flourish, he declared, 'Your chariot awaits!' before showering Julie with compliments, assuring her that she would undoubtedly be the cynosure of all eyes.

The other girls' escorts soon followed suit, and the group departed in taxis for the party venue. However, before they left, Julie's father felt compelled to deliver a cautionary reminder. 'Have a wonderful time, but don't forget that big brother is watching.' The ambiguous nature of his remark left everyone wondering whether it was intended as a lighthearted jest or a veiled warning, serving as a sobering reminder amidst the burgeoning excitement.

questions.answer: Answers may vary. Common celebrations include: having parties with friends/family, going out to restaurants, organizing gatherings at home, giving gifts, making cakes, organizing surprise parties, going on trips, or having intimate dinners. Some cultures have special traditions.
questions.question: How do you and your friends celebrate birthdays?

questions.answer: Answers may vary. Reasons for: marks life milestones, shows appreciation for being alive, strengthens relationships, creates memories, tradition and culture, makes people feel valued. Reasons against: just another day, commercialized, can be stressful, age sensitivity, prefer low-key celebrations.
questions.question: Do you think it is important to celebrate birthdays? Why or why not?

questions.answer: Answers may vary. Possible reasons: childhood birthdays mark developmental milestones and are exciting for children; milestone birthdays in old age (60th, 70th, 80th, etc.) celebrate longevity and are emotionally significant; middle-aged people may be too busy with work/family; certain ages (18th, 21st) mark legal/social transitions; cultural emphasis on youth and wisdom of age.
questions.question: Why do you think that usually only the very young and very old have birthday celebrations?

mock_data.translation:
Julining o'n sakkizinchi tug'ilgan kuni edi va uning ota-onasi qizining hayotidagi ushbu bayram kunini nishonlash uchun rasmiy ziyofat uyushtirishgan edi. Aslida, ziyofatdan keyingi kun ham bayram kuni bo'lar edi, nafaqat Juli uchun, balki ziyofatda bo'ladigan ko'plab do'stlari uchun ham. O'sha kun maktabning yakuniy imtihonlari natijalari e'lon qilinadigan kun edi, haqiqat momenti, ba'zi martabalar boshlanadigan va boshqalari tark etiladigan vaqt.

Ehtimol ziyofat o'tkazish uchun eng yaxshi vaqt emas edi, ammo Juli o'z tug'ilgan kunini natijalar e'lon qilinguncha kechiktirmasdan, aniq shu kunda nishonlashni xohlagan edi. Uning ko'pchilik talaba do'stlari ingliz tili o'qituvchisi aytganidek, qo'ylarni echkilardan ajratadigan e'lonni kutayotganlarida qilish uchun yoqimli biror narsa bo'lganidan xursand edilar. Bundan tashqari, natijalar ma'lum bo'lgandan keyin, hammada nishonlanadigan narsa bo'lmaydi.

Bu kecha, hamma natijalarni unutishga, ochilishga va keyingi kun qanday yangilik keltirishidan qat'i nazar, yaxshi vaqt o'tkazishga qaror qilgan edi. Tom aytganidek, "Ey, ich, shod bo'l, chunki ertaga o'lamiz!" Talabalar imtihondan oldin haftalar davomida juda qattiq o'qigan edilar va ko'p ijtimoiy hayotga vaqt bo'lmagan edi. Bu kecha ular yo'qotilgan vaqtni qoplashni rejalashtirgan edilar. Julining ota-onasi juda badavlat edilar va yaxshi ziyofat uyushtirishga qodir edilar. U yerda dabdabali bufet, shampan va raqs uchun orkestr bo'lishi kerak edi. Hech qanday xarajat ayamagan edi.

Ziyofat boshlanishiga ko'p vaqt qolmagan edi va bir nechta qizlar Julining uyida yig'ilishgan edi, shunda ular birga tayyorlanish quvonchidan bahramand bo'lishlari mumkin edi. Ularning hammasi eng chiroyli kiyinishni rejalashtirgan edilar va shuning uchun tayyorlanish ancha vaqt oldi. Ular nihoyat tugagandan keyin, qo'ng'iroq chaldi va Julining bu kechki hamrohi Mayk paydo bo'ldi. "Sizning aravaniz kutmoqda!" deb qichqirdi u Juliga qanchalik chiroyli ko'rinishini va u, albatta, balning go'zali bo'lishini aytishdan oldin.

Boshqa qizlarning hamrohlari tez orada Maykga qo'shildilar va hamma taksida ziyofatga ketishdi, ammo Julining otasi ular uchun ogohlantiruvchi so'z aytishdan oldin emas. "Ajoyib vaqt o'tkazing, ammo unutmangki, katta aka sizni kuzatib turadi." Hech kim u hazillashayotganmi yoki yo'qmi aniq bilmadi.

mock_data.translationB1:
Bu Julining o'n sakkizinchi tug'ilgan kuni edi va ota-onasi ziyofat uyushtirishayotgan edi. Bu Juli uchun alohida kun edi. Ertasi kuni ham muhim bo'ladi, nafaqat Juli uchun, balki uning do'stlari uchun ham. O'sha kuni ular yakuniy maktab imtihonlari natijalarini olishadi. Bu ba'zi odamlar o'z orzularidagi ishlarini boshlaydigan, boshqalari esa yangi reja topishga majbur bo'ladigan vaqt edi.

Balki ziyofat uchun eng yaxshi vaqt emasdir, lekin Juli o'z tug'ilgan kunini aynan o'sha kuni nishonlashni xohladi. U natijalardan keyin kutishni xohlamadi. Uning ko'pgina do'stlari kutish davomida qiziqarli bir ish bilan mashg'ul bo'lishdan xursand edilar. Ularning o'qituvchisi natijalar kim yaxshi o'qiganini va kim o'qimaganini ko'rsatishini aytdi. Shuningdek, natijalardan so'ng hamma ham xursand bo'lmaydi.

Bugun kechqurun hamma natijalarni unutmoqchi edi. Ular ertangi kun nima olib kelishidan qat'i nazar, dam olish va kayf qilishni xohlashdi. Tom shunday dedi: 'Kelinglar yeymiz, ichamiz va xursand bo'lamiz, chunki ertaga nima bo'lishini bilmaymiz!' Talabalar imtihonlardan oldin bir necha hafta davomida qattiq o'qishgan edi. Ularning tashqariga chiqishga vaqtlari yo'q edi. Bugun kechqurun ular zavqlanishni xohlashdi. Julining ota-onasida yaxshi ziyofat o'tkazishga yetarli pul bor edi. Katta bufet, shampan vinosi va raqsga tushish uchun ansambl bor edi. Ular uni ajoyib ziyofat qilish uchun ko'p pul sarflashdi.

Ziyofat boshlanish arafasida edi. Ba'zi qizlar birgalikda tayyorgarlik ko'rish uchun Julining uyida uchrashishdi. Ularning barchasi chiroyli kiyinishni rejalashtirishgan edi. Tayyorlanish juda ko'p vaqt talab qildi. Ular nihoyat tayyor bo'lishganda, qo'ng'iroq jiringladi. Bu Mayk, Julining o'sha oqshomdagi jufti edi. U shunday dedi: 'Sizning mashinangiz keldi!' U Juliga u go'zal ko'rinayotganini va u ziyofatdagi eng go'zal qiz bo'lishini aytdi.

Boshqa qizlarning juftlari ham ko'p o'tmay kelishdi. Hamma taksida ziyofatga ketishdi. Lekin ular ketishdan oldin, Julining otasi ularga bir narsa dedi. U shunday dedi: 'Yaxshi vaqt o'tkazinglar, lekin men sizlarni kuzatib turganimni unutmanglar.' Hech kim uning jiddiy yoki hazillashayotganini bilmas edi.

Ziyofatda musiqa baland edi va hamma raqsga tushardi. Juli do'stlari va oilasi uchun minnatdor edi. U imtihon natijalari qanday bo'lishidan qat'i nazar, unga g'amxo'rlik qiladigan odamlari borligini bilardi. U tabassum qildi va raqs maydonida do'stlariga qo'shildi, oqshomdan maksimal darajada foydalanishga qaror qildi.
mock_data.translationB2:
Julining o'n sakkizinchi tug'ilgan kuni edi, bu muhim bosqich, va ota-onasi buni nishonlash uchun rasmiy ziyofat uyushtirishdi. Ertasi kuni nafaqat Juli, balki uning ko'plab do'stlari uchun ham yanada katta ahamiyatga ega edi. Bu ularning yakuniy imtihon natijalari e'lon qilinadigan kun bo'lib, bu ularning kelajagini shakllantiradigan, ba'zi eshiklarni ochib, boshqalarini yopadigan hal qiluvchi lahza edi.

Balki vaqt jihatidan ideal emasdir, lekin Juli natijalardan keyinga qoldirmasdan, tug'ilgan kunini aynan o'sha kuni nishonlashni talab qildi. Ko'pchilik do'stlari natijalarni hayajon bilan kutish jarayonida dam olish va ko'ngil ochish imkoniyatini qadrlashdi. Ingliz tili o'qituvchisi ta'kidlaganidek, natijalar bug'doyni somondan ajratib beradi. Qolaversa, hamma ham o'z ballarini bilib, xursandchilik kayfiyatida bo'lmaydi.

O'sha kecha hamma ertangi kun nima olib kelishidan qat'i nazar, bo'lajak natijalarni unutishga va hordiq chiqarishga qaror qildi. Tom hazillashib aytganidek, "Yeng, iching va xursandchilik qiling, chunki ertaga o'lamiz!" Talabalar imtihonlarga tayyorgarlik ko'rish uchun bir necha hafta davomida tinimsiz mehnat qilishdi va muloqotga kam vaqt qoldirishdi. Bugun ular o'tkazib yuborilgan vaqtning o'rnini to'ldirmoqchi. Julining ota-onasi moddiy jihatdan ta'minlangan edi va qimmatbaho bufet, shampan vinosi va raqs uchun jonli musiqa guruhi bilan to'ldirilgan dabdabali ziyofat uyushtirishga qurbi yetardi. Unutilmas oqshomni ta'minlash uchun hech qanday xarajat ayamadi.

Ziyofat yaqinlashar ekan, bir nechta qizlar Julining uyida yig'ilib, birgalikda tayyorgarlik ko'rish hayajonidan zavqlanishdi. Ular odamlarni lol qoldirishga harakat qilishdi, bu esa sezilarli vaqt va kuch talab qildi. Ular tashqi ko'rinishiga so'nggi teginishlarni qo'shayotgan paytda, qo'ng'iroq jiringladi. Bu Mayk edi, Julining o'sha oqshomdagi hamrohi. "Sizning aravangiz sizni kutmoqda!" dedi u, Julining go'zalligini maqtadi va u, shubhasiz, kechaning yulduzi bo'lishini e'lon qildi.

Tez orada boshqa qizlarning hamrohlari ham kelishdi va guruh taksida ziyofatga jo'nab ketdi. Ketishdan oldin Julining otasi ularga ogohlantiruvchi so'z aytdi. "Ajoyib vaqt o'tkazinglar, lekin men sizlarni kuzatib turishimni unutmanglar". U jiddiy gapiryaptimi yoki shunchaki hazillashayaptimi, noma'lum edi, bu esa kechaning intiqligiga sirli bir tus berdi. Ularning barchasi shaharni yoritishga tayyor edilar. Havoda hayajon bor edi va ziyofat barcha ishtirokchilar uchun unutilmas tajriba bo'lishga va'da berdi, imtihon natijalarining achchiq haqiqatlari bilan yuzlashishdan oldingi xush kelibsiz chalg'itish edi.
mock_data.translationC1:
Juliening o‘n sakkizinchi tug‘ilgan kuni yaqinlashar edi va ota-onasi qizining hayotidagi bu muhim voqeani nishonlash uchun dabdabali bayram tashkil qilishmoqda edi. Biroq, vaqt biroz nozik edi. Ertasi kuni nafaqat Julie uchun, balki partiyada qatnashadigan ko'plab tengdoshlari uchun ham burilish nuqtasi bo'lishi kutilmoqda edi. Ularning yakuniy imtihon natijalari e'lon qilinishi yaqin edi, bu ko'p yillik akademik mehnatni tasdiqlaydigan yoki yangi umidlarni puchga chiqaradigan haqiqiy sinov vositasi edi.

Ba'zilar bunday muhim e'lon arafasida bayram tadbirini o'tkazishning to'g'riligiga shubha bilan qarashlari mumkin edi, lekin Julie tug'ilgan kunini aynan o'sha kuni nishonlashga qat'iy qaror qilgan edi, nima bo'lishidan qat'i nazar. Sinfdoshlari uchun partiya xush kelibsiz tanaffusni taqdim etdi, ularning akademik taqdirlari e'lon qilinishidan oldingi ortib borayotgan xavotirdan uzoqlashish imkoniyatini berdi. Ingliz tili o'qituvchisi aytganidek, natijalar bug'doyni xashakdan ajratadi va potentsial umidsizlikka olib keladigan natijalarga duch kelish istiqboli uzoq soyani tashladi.

O'sha oqshom, ertangi kun nima olib kelishidan qat'i nazar, barcha akademik hukmlar haqidagi fikrlarni cheklab qo'yish, xursandchilik ruhini qabul qilish to'g'risida jamoaviy qaror qabul qilindi. Be'parvolik tuyg'usini aks ettirgan holda, Tom hazillashdi: "Yeng, iching va xursand bo'ling, chunki ertaga biz jazoga duch kelishimiz mumkin!" O'tgan haftalar tinimsiz o'qish bilan ajralib turdi va ijtimoiy tadbirlar uchun deyarli joy qolmadi. Shuning uchun partiya yo'qotilgan vaqtni qoplash va munosib bo'lgan beparvolikdan bahramand bo'lish imkoniyatini taqdim etdi. Yaxshiyamki, Juliening ota-onasi moddiy jihatdan ta'minlangan edi va hashamatli bufet, bepul shampan vinosi va oqshom bayramlariga saundtrek taqdim etadigan jonli guruh bilan to'ldirilgan ekstravagant tadbirning xarajatlarini qoplay olishdi. Haqiqatan ham, unutilmas bayramni ta'minlash uchun hech qanday xarajat ayamadi.

Belgilangan soat yaqinlashar ekan, Juliening bir nechta dugonalari uning uyida yig'ilishdi, birgalikda tayyorlanishning partiyadan oldingi marosimida ishtirok etishga intilishdi. Ularning barchasi taassurot qoldirish uchun kiyinishga qaror qilishdi, bu jarayon muqarrar ravishda sezilarli vaqtni oldi. Ular o'zgarishlarini yakunlaganlarida, qo'ng'iroq chalinib, Juliening o'sha oqshom uchun tayinlangan hamrohi Maykning kelganini e'lon qildi. U hashamat bilan: "Sizning aravangiz sizni kutmoqda!" deb e'lon qildi va Juliega maqtovlar yog'dirib, u, shubhasiz, barcha ko'zlarning markazi bo'lishiga ishontirdi.

Boshqa qizlarning hamrohlari ham tez orada unga ergashishdi va guruh taksida partiya o'tkaziladigan joyga jo'nab ketishdi. Biroq, ular ketishidan oldin, Juliening otasi ogohlantiruvchi eslatmani etkazishga majbur bo'ldi. "Yaxshi dam oling, lekin katta aka kuzatib turganini unutmang." Uning gapining noaniqligi hamma uni engil hazil yoki yashirin ogohlantirish sifatida qabul qilinganmi yoki yo'qmi, deb o'ylashga majbur qildi va bu ortib borayotgan hayajon o'rtasida hushyor eslatma bo'lib xizmat qildi.
